title: adenophora verticillata var. marsupiiflora
intro: Adenophora verticillata var. marsupiiflora, commonly known as  Sibirian ginseng or Bearberry ginseng, is a plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Adenophora verticillata var. marsupiiflora include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
